english.notes:
Section 61 of the Serious Organised Crime and Police Act 2005 provides that this offence applies to any offence:-
listed in Schedule 2 to the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002, offences under sections 15, 16, 17 or 18 of the Terrorism Act 2000, offences under section 170 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979, any offence under section 17 of the Theft Act 1968, any offence under section 1 of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981, any offence under section 1 of the Criminal Law Act 1977.

other.penalty:
Fifty one weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Until the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the penalty will be - Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
